jobs.description:

There are plenty of other work possibilities available through discussion! Does a gross hourly salary of €14.99, travel reimbursement, and free training opportunities sound appealing to you? Read on and apply today!

Manpower agency is looking for a Postal Worker for PostNL in the Zeist region, with the exact work location being Nieuwegein.

As a mail sorter, your primary task is, of course, sorting mail! This is done using a sorting machine. Additionally, there are various other work opportunities at PostNL. What you'll get:

    - Gross hourly salary of €14.99 
    
- Travel reimbursement according to the PostNL collective labor agreement
    
- Gain logistics experience at a reputable company
    
- Work within a pleasant, friendly, and motivating team
    
- On-the-job training and the opportunity to be trained for multiple machines
    
- Part-time job of fifteen hours per week
    
- Free access to over two hundred training courses via Manpower Academy

    - Minimum age of eighteen
    
- Ability to work standing and lift heavier containers
    
- Proficient in Dutch and/or English for communication and safety instructions
    
- Availability for a minimum of three shifts per week
    
- A VOG (Certificate of Good Conduct) if required
    
- Personal transportation to commute to the workplace

Lastly, it would be beneficial if you live in (or near) Zeist, Nieuwegein, Utrecht, or Maarssen.
